page.title: Staff Assignments
page.description: Groups are labels; assignments control access. Operators can only view and operate accounts assigned to them, while admins see all.

forbidden.pageDesc: Manage staff accounts, passwords, and account assignments.
forbidden.title: 403 Admin Access Required
forbidden.description: Staff Assignments is restricted to administrators: managing staff accounts, passwords, and assignments requires admin privileges. Your current role is operator and the API will also return 403. Contact an administrator if needed.

actions.adminNoAssignHint: Admins can access all accounts; no assignment needed
actions.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account

matrix.title: Assignment Matrix
matrix.subtitle: Overview of accounts assigned to each staff member. Click Assign Accounts on a row to adjust in bulk, or check ownership inside the picker.

empty.usersDesc: Create a staff member and assign accounts so they can sign in and operate on duty.
empty.matrixDesc: Click Assign Accounts in the staff table to allocate accounts to operators.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete staff "{{username}}"?
deleteConfirm.content: This staff member will no longer be able to sign in. Their accounts will become unassigned without affecting the accounts themselves.

assignModal.title: Assign Accounts: {{name}}
assignModal.saveFailedFallback: Failed to save. Please try again later.

userModal.title: New Staff
userModal.createFailedFallback: Failed to create staff. Please try again later.
userModal.passwordExtra: Stored as a bcrypt hash only; no one (including admins) can view the plaintext password.

passwordModal.title: Change Password: {{username}}
passwordModal.updateFailedFallback: Failed to update password. Please try again later.
passwordModal.newPasswordExtra: Existing login tokens remain valid after changing the password. Disable the account first if you suspect a compromise.
